exhibits.argument: Buyer reports existing images must be re-screenshotted because direct image extraction is not supported.

exhibits.quote: Instantly capture non-selectable text from YouTube videos, PDFs, images, online courses, screencasts, presentations, webpages, video tutorials, photos, etc.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists images among sources for instant text capture.

exhibits.quote: I use it everyday to help me copy text from images and videos when taking notes.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms daily use copying text from images.
